stack: PAISolver (AWS Batch, Fargate linux/amd64, 2 vCPU / 4 GiB per job, maxvCpus 32, one attempt per job)

optimisation.note: Every solved point ran as its own Batch job; files were re-hashed against the job's result.json and tool versions checked against the pins.

issues: First submit was denied: SubmitJob by job-definition name is authorised against the unversioned ARN, which the policy now includes; IAM propagation took about a minute.
With zero solved points the optimiser used to crash fitting the GP; it now stops the rounds and reports the measured failures.
